  home_dir: /var/lib/gearbox

  servers:
    pg:
      engine: postgres
      host: postgres.gearbox-p4.svc.cluster.local
      port: 5432
      user: integration
      password: ${GEARS_PG_PASSWORD}
      params:
        sslmode: disable
oop_http:
  listen_addr: 0.0.0.0:8090
  advertise_uri: http://authz.gearbox-p4.svc.cluster.local:8090
  allow_loopback_advertise: false
  internal_auth:
    audiences:
    - toolkit-internal
    provider: kube
    token_path: /var/run/secrets/tokens/toolkit-internal
gears:
  authn-resolver:
    config: {}
  authz-resolver:
    config: {}
  oidc-authn-plugin:
    config:
      http_client:
        custom_ca_certificate_paths:
        - /app/oidc-ca/ca.crt
      jwt:
        claim_mapping:
          subject_id: sub
          subject_tenant_id: tenant_id
          token_scopes: scope
        expected_audience:
        - integration-demo
        trusted_issuers:
        - issuer: https://mock-idp.gearbox-p4.svc.cluster.local
      s2s_oauth:
        default_subject_type: gts.cf.core.security.subject_user.v1~
        discovery_url: https://mock-idp.gearbox-p4.svc.cluster.local
  static-authz-plugin:
    config: {}
  types-registry:
    database:
      server: pg
      dbname: types_registry
    config:
      {}

=== helm/integration-demo/Chart.yaml
# GENERATED by gearbox <version> -- do not edit. Run `gearbox generate` to regenerate.
apiVersion: v2
name: integration-demo
description: Generated gearbox chart; workloads live in charts/
type: application
version: "0.1.0"
appVersion: "0.1.0"
dependencies:
  - name: authz
    version: "0.1.0"
    repository: "file://charts/authz"
    condition: authz.enabled
  - name: checkout
    version: "0.1.0"
    repository: "file://charts/checkout"
    condition: checkout.enabled
  - name: cluster
    version: "0.1.0"
    repository: "file://charts/cluster"
    condition: cluster.enabled
  - name: flight-control
    version: "0.1.0"
    repository: "file://charts/flight-control"
    condition: flight-control.enabled
  - name: payments
    version: "0.1.0"
    repository: "file://charts/payments"
    condition: payments.enabled

=== helm/integration-demo/charts/authz/templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "authz.name" -}}
{{- default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "authz.fullname" -}}
{{- if .Values.fullnameOverride }}
{{- .Values.fullnameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- $name := default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride }}
{{- if contains $name .Release.Name }}
{{- .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name $name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "authz.chart" -}}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Chart.Name .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "authz.labels" -}}
helm.sh/chart: {{ include "authz.chart" . }}
{{ include "authz.selectorLabels" . }}
{{- if .Chart.AppVersion }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
{{- end }}
app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
{{- with .Values.global }}{{- with .commonLabels }}
{{ toYaml . }}
{{- end }}{{- end }}
{{- with .Values.commonLabels }}
{{ toYaml . }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "authz.annotations" -}}
{{- with .Values.global }}{{- with .commonAnnotations }}
{{ toYaml . }}
{{- end }}{{- end }}
{{- with .Values.commonAnnotations }}
{{ toYaml . }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "authz.selectorLabels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "authz.name" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "authz.serviceAccountName" -}}
{{- if .Values.serviceAccount.create }}
{{- default (include "authz.fullname" .) .Values.serviceAccount.name }}
{{- else }}
{{- default "default" .Values.serviceAccount.name }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/authz/templates/configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "authz.fullname" . }}-config
  labels:
    {{- include "authz.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
  {{- with (include "authz.annotations" . | trim) }}
  annotations:
    {{- . | nindent 4 }}
  {{- end }}
data:
  authz.yaml: |
{{ .Files.Get "files/authz.yaml" | indent 4 }}
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/authz/templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "authz.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "authz.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
  {{- with (include "authz.annotations" . | trim) }}
  annotations:
    {{- . | nindent 4 }}
  {{- end }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  {{- with .Values.revisionHistoryLimit }}
  revisionHistoryLimit: {{ . }}
  {{- end }}
  {{- with .Values.strategy }}
  strategy:
    {{- toYaml . | nindent 4 }}
  {{- end }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "authz.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "authz.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- with .Values.global }}{{- with .commonLabels }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}{{- end }}
        {{- with .Values.commonLabels }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
        {{- with .Values.podLabels }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
      annotations:
        checksum/config: {{ include (print $.Template.BasePath "/configmap.yaml") . | sha256sum }}
        {{- with (include "authz.annotations" . | trim) }}
        {{- . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
        {{- with .Values.podAnnotations }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: {{ include "authz.serviceAccountName" . }}
      automountServiceAccountToken: {{ .Values.automountServiceAccountToken }}
      {{- with .Values.priorityClassName }}
      priorityClassName: {{ . }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.terminationGracePeriodSeconds }}
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: {{ . }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.topologySpreadConstraints }}
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.initContainers }}
      initContainers:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- if and .Values.global .Values.global.imagePullSecrets }}
      imagePullSecrets:
        {{- range .Values.global.imagePullSecrets }}
        - name: {{ . }}
        {{- end }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.podSecurityContext }}
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.nodeSelector }}
      nodeSelector:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.affinity }}
      affinity:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.tolerations }}
      tolerations:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      containers:
        - name: authz
          {{- $registry := .Values.image.registry }}
          {{- if and .Values.global .Values.global.imageRegistry }}
          {{- $registry = .Values.global.imageRegistry }}
          {{- end }}
          image: "{{ with $registry }}{{ . }}/{{ end }}{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
          command:
            - "gbx-authz"
          args:
            - --config
            - /etc/gearbox/authz.yaml
          {{- with .Values.containerSecurityContext }}
          securityContext:
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
          {{- end }}
          ports:

            - name: http
              containerPort: 8090
              protocol: TCP

          env:
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
            - name: POD_NAMESPACE
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.namespace

            - name: TOOLKIT_DIRECTORY_ENDPOINT
              value: "http://flight-control-grpc.gearbox-p4.svc.cluster.local:50051"

            {{- if and .Values.existingSecret .Values.secretKeys }}
            {{- range .Values.secretKeys }}
            - name: {{ . | quote }}
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ $.Values.existingSecret | quote }}
                  key: {{ . | quote }}
            {{- end }}
            {{- end }}
            {{- with .Values.database }}
            - name: {{ .passwordEnv | quote }}
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ .existingSecret | quote }}
                  key: {{ .passwordEnv | quote }}
            {{- end }}
            {{- with .Values.extraEnv }}
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
            {{- end }}
          {{- if .Values.startupProbe.enabled }}
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8090
            {{- omit .Values.startupProbe "enabled" | toYaml | nindent 12 }}
          {{- end }}
          {{- if .Values.livenessProbe.enabled }}
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8090
            {{- omit .Values.livenessProbe "enabled" | toYaml | nindent 12 }}
          {{- end }}
          {{- if .Values.readinessProbe.enabled }}
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /readyz
              port: 8090
            {{- omit .Values.readinessProbe "enabled" | toYaml | nindent 12 }}
          {{- end }}
          {{- with .Values.resources }}
          resources:
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
          {{- end }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config
              mountPath: /etc/gearbox/authz.yaml
              subPath: authz.yaml
              readOnly: true
            - name: home
              mountPath: /var/lib/gearbox
            {{- with .Values.extraVolumeMounts }}
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
            {{- end }}
        {{- with .Values.extraContainers }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
      volumes:
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: {{ include "authz.fullname" . }}-config
        - name: home
          {{- if eq .Values.homeVolume.type "persistentVolumeClaim" }}
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: {{ required "homeVolume.claimName is required when homeVolume.type is persistentVolumeClaim" .Values.homeVolume.claimName }}
          {{- else if .Values.homeVolume.sizeLimit }}
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: {{ .Values.homeVolume.sizeLimit }}
          {{- else }}

=== helm/integration-demo/charts/cluster/charts/toolkit-common/Chart.yaml
# GENERATED by gearbox <version> -- do not edit. Run `gearbox generate` to regenerate.

apiVersion: v2
description: "Shared templates for the charts of gears-rust executable units: a hardened Deployment, Services, Ingress, ServiceAccount, TokenReview RBAC and the validation helpers production presets are checked with (ADR-0004 amendment)."
name: toolkit-common
type: library
version: 0.1.0
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/cluster/charts/toolkit-common/README.md
# toolkit-common

A Helm **library** chart: it renders nothing by itself. Unit charts
(`apps/cf-gears-flight-control/deploy/helm/flight-control`,
`gears/system/cluster/cluster/deploy/helm/cluster`) declare it as a dependency and
call its named templates, so every packaged unit gets the same hardening and the
same production checks (gears-rust ADR-0004 amendment, ADR-0011 §1/§3).

| Template | Renders |
|---|---|
| `toolkit-common.deployment` | Deployment: non-root (uid 1000), read-only root filesystem, a writable `emptyDir` home, the config from a ConfigMap, a projected platform-audience token, separate liveness/readiness probes, `POD_NAME`/`POD_NAMESPACE` |
| `toolkit-common.service` | ClusterIP Service with a **fixed** name (other units address it by name) |
| `toolkit-common.ingress` | Ingress to one Service port, only when enabled |
| `toolkit-common.serviceAccount` | ServiceAccount; the token is not automounted unless the unit validates tokens |
| `toolkit-common.tokenReviewRbac` | ClusterRole + ClusterRoleBinding for `tokenreviews` `create`, for units that validate platform tokens |
| `toolkit-common.require` | `fail` with a message when a condition does not hold |

Two different tokens, never one:
* the **API-server client credential** (the automounted ServiceAccount token) is
  what a validating unit calls TokenReview with;
* the **platform token** is a projected token with an explicit audience
  (`toolkit-internal` by default), mounted at `/var/run/secrets/tokens/<audience>`,
  and is what the unit presents to other units.

`helm dependency build` copies this chart into each unit chart's `charts/`, so a
packaged unit chart does not need this checkout.
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/cluster/charts/toolkit-common/templates/_deployment.tpl
{{/*
A hardened Deployment for one executable unit. Call with:

  (dict "root" $ "unit" "<unit>" "w" <workload values> "configChecksum" "<sha>")

where the workload values are:

  image:          {repository, tag, digest (optional, wins over tag), pullPolicy}
  replicas:       int
  strategy:       "Recreate" | "RollingUpdate"
  serviceAccount: name (fixed: the directory admits a registrar by it)
  args:           container args, e.g. ["--config", "/app/config/x.yaml", "run"]
  configMap:      ConfigMap holding the unit's configuration
  configFile:     its key, mounted at /app/config/<configFile>
  homeDir:        writable directory the runtime's `server.home_dir` points at
  ports:          [{name, containerPort}]
  probes:         {port: <port name>, liveness: "/healthz", readiness: "/readyz"}
  platformToken:  {enabled, audience, expirationSeconds} -- a projected token
                  mounted at /var/run/secrets/tokens/<audience>
  env:            extra env entries (list), e.g. secretKeyRef to an existing Secret
  extraVolumes, extraVolumeMounts: read-only inputs the unit's configuration
                  names, e.g. an IdP's CA bundle from a ConfigMap
  resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, affinity: passed through
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.deployment" -}}
{{- $w := .w -}}
{{- $labels := dict "root" .root "name" .unit -}}
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ .unit }}
  labels:
    {{- include "toolkit-common.labels" $labels | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ $w.replicas }}
  strategy:
    type: {{ $w.strategy }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "toolkit-common.selectorLabels" $labels | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "toolkit-common.labels" $labels | nindent 8 }}
      annotations:
        checksum/config: {{ .configChecksum }}
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: {{ $w.serviceAccount }}
      automountServiceAccountToken: {{ $w.automountServiceAccountToken | default false }}
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      {{- with $w.nodeSelector }}
      nodeSelector:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with $w.tolerations }}
      tolerations:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with $w.affinity }}
      affinity:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      containers:
        - name: {{ .unit }}
          {{- if $w.image.digest }}
          image: "{{ $w.image.repository }}@{{ $w.image.digest }}"
          {{- else }}
          image: "{{ $w.image.repository }}:{{ required "image.tag (or image.digest) is required" $w.image.tag }}"
          {{- end }}
          imagePullPolicy: {{ $w.image.pullPolicy | default "IfNotPresent" }}
          args:
            {{- toYaml $w.args | nindent 12 }}
          env:
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
            - name: POD_NAMESPACE
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.namespace
            - name: HOME
              value: {{ $w.homeDir | quote }}
            {{- with $w.env }}
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
            {{- end }}
          ports:
            {{- range $w.ports }}
            - name: {{ .name }}
              containerPort: {{ .containerPort }}
              protocol: TCP
            {{- end }}
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: {{ $w.probes.liveness }}
              port: {{ $w.probes.port }}
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: {{ $w.probes.readiness }}
              port: {{ $w.probes.port }}
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: {{ $w.probes.liveness }}
              port: {{ $w.probes.port }}
            periodSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 60
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          {{- with $w.resources }}
          resources:
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
          {{- end }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config
              mountPath: /app/config/{{ $w.configFile }}
              subPath: {{ $w.configFile }}
              readOnly: true
            - name: home
              mountPath: {{ $w.homeDir }}
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
            {{- if $w.platformToken.enabled }}
            - name: platform-token
              mountPath: /var/run/secrets/tokens
              readOnly: true
            {{- end }}
            {{- with $w.extraVolumeMounts }}
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
            {{- end }}
      volumes:
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: {{ $w.configMap }}
        - name: home
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
        {{- if $w.platformToken.enabled }}
        - name: platform-token
          projected:
            sources:
              - serviceAccountToken:
                  path: {{ $w.platformToken.audience }}
                  audience: {{ $w.platformToken.audience }}
                  expirationSeconds: {{ $w.platformToken.expirationSeconds | default 3600 }}
        {{- end }}
        {{- with $w.extraVolumes }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
{{- end }}
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/cluster/charts/toolkit-common/templates/_names.tpl
{{/*
Labels for one unit. Call with (dict "root" $ "name" "<unit>").
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.selectorLabels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .name }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .root.Release.Name }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "toolkit-common.labels" -}}
helm.sh/chart: {{ printf "%s-%s" .root.Chart.Name .root.Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{ include "toolkit-common.selectorLabels" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .root.Chart.AppVersion | default .root.Chart.Version | quote }}
app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .root.Release.Service }}
app.kubernetes.io/part-of: gears-rust
{{- end }}

{{/*
`fail` unless `cond` holds. Call with (list <cond> "<message>").
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.require" -}}
{{- if not (index . 0) }}
{{- fail (printf "%s" (index . 1)) }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
`fail` when a listen address does not end in the port its Service and
container expose. Call with (list "<address>" <port> "<what>").
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.requirePort" -}}
{{- $address := toString (index . 0) -}}
{{- $port := toString (index . 1) -}}
{{- if not (hasSuffix (printf ":%s" $port) $address) }}
{{- fail (printf "%s listens on `%s`, but the chart's Service and container expose port %s" (index . 2) $address $port) }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
`fail` when the configuration carries a literal credential. A credential is
either a field named like one (`password`, `secret`, `token`, `client_secret`,
`api_key`) or the password of a URL's userinfo or of a `password=` parameter.
Its whole value must be one `${VAR}` placeholder an existing Secret fills
(through `secretEnv`), or empty -- filled by the environment. Call with
(list <value> "<path>").
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.noLiteralSecrets" -}}
{{- $value := index . 0 -}}
{{- $path := index . 1 -}}
{{- $placeholder := "^\\$\\{[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\}$" -}}
{{- if kindIs "map" $value -}}
{{- range $key, $item := $value -}}
{{- if and (regexMatch "(?i)^(password|secret|token|client_secret|api_key)$" $key) (not (kindIs "invalid" $item)) (not (and (kindIs "string" $item) (or (eq $item "") (regexMatch $placeholder $item)))) }}
{{- fail (printf "%s.%s holds a literal credential; write a ${VAR} placeholder and map it from an existing Secret with secretEnv" $path $key) }}
{{- end -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.noLiteralSecrets" (list $item (printf "%s.%s" $path $key)) -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- else if kindIs "slice" $value -}}
{{- range $i, $item := $value -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.noLiteralSecrets" (list $item (printf "%s[%d]" $path $i)) -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- else if kindIs "string" $value -}}
{{- range $found := regexFindAll "://[^/@:]+:[^@/]+@" $value -1 -}}
{{- if not (regexMatch $placeholder (regexReplaceAll "^://[^/@:]+:([^@/]+)@$" $found "${1}")) }}
{{- fail (printf "%s holds a literal credential in a URL; write a ${VAR} placeholder and map it from an existing Secret with secretEnv" $path) }}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- range $found := regexFindAll "(?i)password=[^&]*" $value -1 -}}
{{- if not (regexMatch $placeholder (regexReplaceAll "(?i)^password=" $found "")) }}
{{- fail (printf "%s holds a literal password parameter; write a ${VAR} placeholder and map it from an existing Secret with secretEnv" $path) }}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end }}
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/cluster/charts/toolkit-common/templates/_service.tpl
{{/*
ClusterIP Service with a fixed name. Call with (dict "root" $ "unit"
"<unit>" "name" "<service>" "ports" (list (dict "name" "http" "port" 8087
"targetPort" "http"))).
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.service" -}}
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ .name }}
  labels:
    {{- include "toolkit-common.labels" (dict "root" .root "name" .unit) | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    {{- include "toolkit-common.selectorLabels" (dict "root" .root "name" .unit) | nindent 4 }}
  ports:
    {{- range .ports }}
    - name: {{ .name }}
      port: {{ .port }}
      targetPort: {{ .targetPort | default .name }}
      protocol: TCP
    {{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
Ingress to one Service port, rendered only when `ingress.enabled`. Call with
(dict "root" $ "unit" "<unit>" "service" "<service>" "port" "<port name>"
"ingress" .Values.ingress).
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.ingress" -}}
{{- if .ingress.enabled }}
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: {{ .service }}
  labels:
    {{- include "toolkit-common.labels" (dict "root" .root "name" .unit) | nindent 4 }}
  {{- with .ingress.annotations }}
  annotations:
    {{- toYaml . | nindent 4 }}
  {{- end }}
spec:
  {{- with .ingress.className }}
  ingressClassName: {{ . }}
  {{- end }}
  {{- with .ingress.tls }}
  tls:
    {{- toYaml . | nindent 4 }}
  {{- end }}
  rules:
    - host: {{ required "ingress.host is required when the ingress is enabled" .ingress.host | quote }}
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: {{ .service }}
                port:
                  name: {{ .port }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/cluster/charts/toolkit-common/templates/_serviceaccount.tpl
{{/*
ServiceAccount. Call with (dict "root" $ "name" "<sa name>" "unit" "<unit>"
"automount" <bool>). `automount` is true only for a unit that validates
platform tokens: TokenReview is called with this token. The platform token a
unit presents is a separate projected volume (see toolkit-common.deployment).
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.serviceAccount" -}}
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: {{ .name }}
  labels:
    {{- include "toolkit-common.labels" (dict "root" .root "name" .unit) | nindent 4 }}
automountServiceAccountToken: {{ .automount | default false }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
TokenReview RBAC for one validating unit. Call with (dict "root" $ "unit"
"<unit>" "serviceAccount" "<sa name>").
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.tokenReviewRbac" -}}
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-%s-tokenreview" .root.Release.Namespace .unit | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    {{- include "toolkit-common.labels" (dict "root" .root "name" .unit) | nindent 4 }}
rules:
  - apiGroups: ["authentication.k8s.io"]
    resources: ["tokenreviews"]
    verbs: ["create"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-%s-tokenreview" .root.Release.Namespace .unit | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    {{- include "toolkit-common.labels" (dict "root" .root "name" .unit) | nindent 4 }}
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: {{ printf "%s-%s-tokenreview" .root.Release.Namespace .unit | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: {{ .serviceAccount }}
    namespace: {{ .root.Release.Namespace }}
{{- end }}
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/cluster/files/cluster.yaml
# cluster-oop: the coordination unit (cache, lock, leader election, profiles)
# as its own pod (DESIGN §3.15, Profile 3; Gearbox ADR-0026 §4).
#
# This file is the chart's configuration template: `templates/configmap.yaml`
# renders it with `tpl` and sets `gears.cluster.config.profiles` from the
# chart's `profiles` value, so template expressions appear only inside quoted
# strings and `tests/production_config.rs` parses the file as it is. Nothing
# here is a secret: a backend password comes from an existing Secret through
# the chart's `secretEnv` and a `${VAR}` in its connection string.
#
# Listeners:
#   50051 gRPC hub -- the four coordination services, behind the Service named
#                     `cluster` that the SDK derives
#                     (cluster.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local:50051). Platform
#                     enforcement required. Never given an Ingress.
#   8090  http     -- this worker's REST surface (no routes today), advertised in
#                     the directory so a consumer's readiness can find `cluster`.
#   8091  probes   -- /healthz, /readyz for the kubelet. In no Service.

server:
  home_dir: "/var/lib/cluster"

logging:
  default:
    console_level: info

oop_http:
  listen_addr: "0.0.0.0:8090"
  probe_bind_addr: "0.0.0.0:8091"
  advertise_uri: "http://cluster.{{ .Release.Namespace }}.svc.cluster.local:8090"
  # The platform credential this worker registers with the directory under:
  # its projected ServiceAccount token, minted for the platform audience.
  internal_auth:
    provider: kube
    audiences: ["{{ .Values.platformAudience }}"]
    token_path: "/var/run/secrets/tokens/{{ .Values.platformAudience }}"

gears:
  cluster:
    config:
      profiles: {}

  grpc-hub:
    config:
      listen_addr: "0.0.0.0:50051"
      advertise_addr: "cluster.{{ .Release.Namespace }}.svc.cluster.local"
      internal_auth:
        provider: kube
        audiences: ["{{ .Values.platformAudience }}"]
        token_path: "/var/run/secrets/tokens/{{ .Values.platformAudience }}"
      internal_auth_enforcement: required
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/cluster/templates/_config.tpl
{{/*
The rendered configuration: `files/cluster.yaml` through `tpl`, the profiles
from values, then `configOverlay`. The production rules (ADR-0011 §1/§3,
P4 a/e) and the replication rule are checked on the result.
*/}}
{{- define "cluster.config" -}}
{{- $cfg := tpl (.Files.Get "files/cluster.yaml") . | fromYaml -}}
{{- $_ := set (index $cfg.gears "cluster" "config") "profiles" (deepCopy .Values.profiles) -}}
{{- $cfg = mustMergeOverwrite $cfg (deepCopy .Values.configOverlay) -}}
{{- $hub := $cfg.gears | dig "grpc-hub" "config" dict -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (eq (dig "internal_auth" "provider" "" $hub) "kube") "production rule: grpc-hub internal_auth.provider must be kube (ADR-0011 §3)") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (eq (toString (dig "internal_auth_enforcement" "" $hub)) "required") "production rule: grpc-hub internal_auth_enforcement must be required (ADR-0011 §3)") -}}
{{- $listen := toString (dig "listen_addr" "" $hub) -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (and $listen (ne $listen "none") (not (hasPrefix "uds://" $listen))) "production rule: a kubernetes hub listens on TCP (ADR-0011 §1)") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (dig "oop_http" "listen_addr" "" $cfg) "cluster-oop needs oop_http.listen_addr: without it there are no probes") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.requirePort" (list $listen 50051 "grpc-hub listen_addr (the port the SDK dials)") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.requirePort" (list (dig "oop_http" "listen_addr" "" $cfg) 8090 "oop_http listen_addr") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.requirePort" (list (dig "oop_http" "probe_bind_addr" "" $cfg) 8091 "oop_http probe_bind_addr") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.noLiteralSecrets" (list $cfg "configuration") -}}
{{- $standalone := false -}}
{{- range $scope, $profile := (dig "cluster" "config" "profiles" dict $cfg.gears) -}}
{{- range $primitive, $binding := $profile -}}
{{- if and (kindIs "map" $binding) (eq (toString (index $binding "provider")) "standalone") -}}
{{- $standalone = true -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- if $standalone -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (eq (int .Values.replicas) 1) "replicas > 1 needs every profile on a shared backend: the standalone backend is process memory") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (eq .Values.strategy "Recreate") "the standalone backend needs strategy Recreate: a surge pod would hold different state") -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- toYaml $cfg -}}
{{- end }}

=== helm/integration-demo/charts/cluster/templates/deployment.yaml

{{- range .Values.secretEnv -}}
{{- $env = append $env (dict "name" .name "valueFrom" (dict "secretKeyRef" (dict "name" .secretName "key" .key))) -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- $w := dict
  "image" .Values.image
  "replicas" .Values.replicas
  "strategy" .Values.strategy
  "serviceAccount" "cluster"
  "automountServiceAccountToken" true
  "args" (list "--config" "/app/config/cluster.yaml")

  "configFile" "cluster.yaml"
  "homeDir" "/var/lib/cluster"
  "env" $env
  "ports" (list
    (dict "name" "grpc" "containerPort" 50051)
    (dict "name" "http" "containerPort" 8090)
    (dict "name" "health" "containerPort" 8091))
  "probes" (dict "port" "health" "liveness" "/healthz" "readiness" "/readyz")

  "resources" .Values.resources
  "nodeSelector" .Values.nodeSelector
  "tolerations" .Values.tolerations
  "affinity" .Values.affinity
-}}

=== helm/integration-demo/charts/cluster/values.yaml
# Production defaults (gears-rust ADR-0004 amendment, ADR-0011 §1/§3); nothing
# here is a secret.

image:
  # The image built from `deploy/docker/cluster-oop.Dockerfile` with
  # `--features k8s-auth`.
  repository: cluster-oop
  tag: ""
  digest: ""
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

# One replica by default. More need every profile on a shared backend -- the
# standalone backend is process memory, so two pods would coordinate nothing --
# and the chart refuses otherwise. With the standalone backend the update is
# `Recreate` for the same reason.
replicas: 1
strategy: Recreate

# Scope name -> per-primitive provider bindings, as the cluster gear reads them
# (`gears.cluster.config.profiles`). A connection string may use `${VAR}` for a
# value `secretEnv` maps from an existing Secret.
profiles: {}

# Environment variables read from existing Secrets only:
#   - {name: PG_PASSWORD, secretName: cluster-db, key: password}
secretEnv: []

# The directory this worker registers with: Flight Control's hub.
directoryEndpoint: ""

platformAudience: toolkit-internal

configOverlay: {}

resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 50m
    memory: 64Mi
  limits:
    memory: 256Mi

nodeSelector: {}
tolerations: []
affinity: {}

=== helm/integration-demo/charts/flight-control/charts/toolkit-common/Chart.yaml
# GENERATED by gearbox <version> -- do not edit. Run `gearbox generate` to regenerate.

apiVersion: v2
description: "Shared templates for the charts of gears-rust executable units: a hardened Deployment, Services, Ingress, ServiceAccount, TokenReview RBAC and the validation helpers production presets are checked with (ADR-0004 amendment)."
name: toolkit-common
type: library
version: 0.1.0
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/flight-control/charts/toolkit-common/README.md
# toolkit-common

A Helm **library** chart: it renders nothing by itself. Unit charts
(`apps/cf-gears-flight-control/deploy/helm/flight-control`,
`gears/system/cluster/cluster/deploy/helm/cluster`) declare it as a dependency and
call its named templates, so every packaged unit gets the same hardening and the
same production checks (gears-rust ADR-0004 amendment, ADR-0011 §1/§3).

| Template | Renders |
|---|---|
| `toolkit-common.deployment` | Deployment: non-root (uid 1000), read-only root filesystem, a writable `emptyDir` home, the config from a ConfigMap, a projected platform-audience token, separate liveness/readiness probes, `POD_NAME`/`POD_NAMESPACE` |
| `toolkit-common.service` | ClusterIP Service with a **fixed** name (other units address it by name) |
| `toolkit-common.ingress` | Ingress to one Service port, only when enabled |
| `toolkit-common.serviceAccount` | ServiceAccount; the token is not automounted unless the unit validates tokens |
| `toolkit-common.tokenReviewRbac` | ClusterRole + ClusterRoleBinding for `tokenreviews` `create`, for units that validate platform tokens |
| `toolkit-common.require` | `fail` with a message when a condition does not hold |

Two different tokens, never one:
* the **API-server client credential** (the automounted ServiceAccount token) is
  what a validating unit calls TokenReview with;
* the **platform token** is a projected token with an explicit audience
  (`toolkit-internal` by default), mounted at `/var/run/secrets/tokens/<audience>`,
  and is what the unit presents to other units.

`helm dependency build` copies this chart into each unit chart's `charts/`, so a
packaged unit chart does not need this checkout.
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/flight-control/charts/toolkit-common/templates/_deployment.tpl
{{/*
A hardened Deployment for one executable unit. Call with:

  (dict "root" $ "unit" "<unit>" "w" <workload values> "configChecksum" "<sha>")

where the workload values are:

  image:          {repository, tag, digest (optional, wins over tag), pullPolicy}
  replicas:       int
  strategy:       "Recreate" | "RollingUpdate"
  serviceAccount: name (fixed: the directory admits a registrar by it)
  args:           container args, e.g. ["--config", "/app/config/x.yaml", "run"]
  configMap:      ConfigMap holding the unit's configuration
  configFile:     its key, mounted at /app/config/<configFile>
  homeDir:        writable directory the runtime's `server.home_dir` points at
  ports:          [{name, containerPort}]
  probes:         {port: <port name>, liveness: "/healthz", readiness: "/readyz"}
  platformToken:  {enabled, audience, expirationSeconds} -- a projected token
                  mounted at /var/run/secrets/tokens/<audience>
  env:            extra env entries (list), e.g. secretKeyRef to an existing Secret
  extraVolumes, extraVolumeMounts: read-only inputs the unit's configuration
                  names, e.g. an IdP's CA bundle from a ConfigMap
  resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, affinity: passed through
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.deployment" -}}
{{- $w := .w -}}
{{- $labels := dict "root" .root "name" .unit -}}
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ .unit }}
  labels:
    {{- include "toolkit-common.labels" $labels | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ $w.replicas }}
  strategy:
    type: {{ $w.strategy }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "toolkit-common.selectorLabels" $labels | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "toolkit-common.labels" $labels | nindent 8 }}
      annotations:
        checksum/config: {{ .configChecksum }}
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: {{ $w.serviceAccount }}
      automountServiceAccountToken: {{ $w.automountServiceAccountToken | default false }}
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      {{- with $w.nodeSelector }}
      nodeSelector:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with $w.tolerations }}
      tolerations:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with $w.affinity }}
      affinity:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      containers:
        - name: {{ .unit }}
          {{- if $w.image.digest }}
          image: "{{ $w.image.repository }}@{{ $w.image.digest }}"
          {{- else }}
          image: "{{ $w.image.repository }}:{{ required "image.tag (or image.digest) is required" $w.image.tag }}"
          {{- end }}
          imagePullPolicy: {{ $w.image.pullPolicy | default "IfNotPresent" }}
          args:
            {{- toYaml $w.args | nindent 12 }}
          env:
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
            - name: POD_NAMESPACE
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.namespace
            - name: HOME
              value: {{ $w.homeDir | quote }}
            {{- with $w.env }}
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
            {{- end }}
          ports:
            {{- range $w.ports }}
            - name: {{ .name }}
              containerPort: {{ .containerPort }}
              protocol: TCP
            {{- end }}
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: {{ $w.probes.liveness }}
              port: {{ $w.probes.port }}
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: {{ $w.probes.readiness }}
              port: {{ $w.probes.port }}
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: {{ $w.probes.liveness }}
              port: {{ $w.probes.port }}
            periodSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 60
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          {{- with $w.resources }}
          resources:
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
          {{- end }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config
              mountPath: /app/config/{{ $w.configFile }}
              subPath: {{ $w.configFile }}
              readOnly: true
            - name: home
              mountPath: {{ $w.homeDir }}
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
            {{- if $w.platformToken.enabled }}
            - name: platform-token
              mountPath: /var/run/secrets/tokens
              readOnly: true
            {{- end }}
            {{- with $w.extraVolumeMounts }}
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
            {{- end }}
      volumes:
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: {{ $w.configMap }}
        - name: home
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
        {{- if $w.platformToken.enabled }}
        - name: platform-token
          projected:
            sources:
              - serviceAccountToken:
                  path: {{ $w.platformToken.audience }}
                  audience: {{ $w.platformToken.audience }}
                  expirationSeconds: {{ $w.platformToken.expirationSeconds | default 3600 }}
        {{- end }}
        {{- with $w.extraVolumes }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
{{- end }}
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/flight-control/charts/toolkit-common/templates/_names.tpl
{{/*
Labels for one unit. Call with (dict "root" $ "name" "<unit>").
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.selectorLabels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .name }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .root.Release.Name }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "toolkit-common.labels" -}}
helm.sh/chart: {{ printf "%s-%s" .root.Chart.Name .root.Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{ include "toolkit-common.selectorLabels" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .root.Chart.AppVersion | default .root.Chart.Version | quote }}
app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .root.Release.Service }}
app.kubernetes.io/part-of: gears-rust
{{- end }}

{{/*
`fail` unless `cond` holds. Call with (list <cond> "<message>").
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.require" -}}
{{- if not (index . 0) }}
{{- fail (printf "%s" (index . 1)) }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
`fail` when a listen address does not end in the port its Service and
container expose. Call with (list "<address>" <port> "<what>").
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.requirePort" -}}
{{- $address := toString (index . 0) -}}
{{- $port := toString (index . 1) -}}
{{- if not (hasSuffix (printf ":%s" $port) $address) }}
{{- fail (printf "%s listens on `%s`, but the chart's Service and container expose port %s" (index . 2) $address $port) }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
`fail` when the configuration carries a literal credential. A credential is
either a field named like one (`password`, `secret`, `token`, `client_secret`,
`api_key`) or the password of a URL's userinfo or of a `password=` parameter.
Its whole value must be one `${VAR}` placeholder an existing Secret fills
(through `secretEnv`), or empty -- filled by the environment. Call with
(list <value> "<path>").
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.noLiteralSecrets" -}}
{{- $value := index . 0 -}}
{{- $path := index . 1 -}}
{{- $placeholder := "^\\$\\{[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\}$" -}}
{{- if kindIs "map" $value -}}
{{- range $key, $item := $value -}}
{{- if and (regexMatch "(?i)^(password|secret|token|client_secret|api_key)$" $key) (not (kindIs "invalid" $item)) (not (and (kindIs "string" $item) (or (eq $item "") (regexMatch $placeholder $item)))) }}
{{- fail (printf "%s.%s holds a literal credential; write a ${VAR} placeholder and map it from an existing Secret with secretEnv" $path $key) }}
{{- end -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.noLiteralSecrets" (list $item (printf "%s.%s" $path $key)) -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- else if kindIs "slice" $value -}}
{{- range $i, $item := $value -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.noLiteralSecrets" (list $item (printf "%s[%d]" $path $i)) -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- else if kindIs "string" $value -}}
{{- range $found := regexFindAll "://[^/@:]+:[^@/]+@" $value -1 -}}
{{- if not (regexMatch $placeholder (regexReplaceAll "^://[^/@:]+:([^@/]+)@$" $found "${1}")) }}
{{- fail (printf "%s holds a literal credential in a URL; write a ${VAR} placeholder and map it from an existing Secret with secretEnv" $path) }}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- range $found := regexFindAll "(?i)password=[^&]*" $value -1 -}}
{{- if not (regexMatch $placeholder (regexReplaceAll "(?i)^password=" $found "")) }}
{{- fail (printf "%s holds a literal password parameter; write a ${VAR} placeholder and map it from an existing Secret with secretEnv" $path) }}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end }}
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/flight-control/charts/toolkit-common/templates/_service.tpl
{{/*
ClusterIP Service with a fixed name. Call with (dict "root" $ "unit"
"<unit>" "name" "<service>" "ports" (list (dict "name" "http" "port" 8087
"targetPort" "http"))).
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.service" -}}
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ .name }}
  labels:
    {{- include "toolkit-common.labels" (dict "root" .root "name" .unit) | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    {{- include "toolkit-common.selectorLabels" (dict "root" .root "name" .unit) | nindent 4 }}
  ports:
    {{- range .ports }}
    - name: {{ .name }}
      port: {{ .port }}
      targetPort: {{ .targetPort | default .name }}
      protocol: TCP
    {{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
Ingress to one Service port, rendered only when `ingress.enabled`. Call with
(dict "root" $ "unit" "<unit>" "service" "<service>" "port" "<port name>"
"ingress" .Values.ingress).
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.ingress" -}}
{{- if .ingress.enabled }}
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: {{ .service }}
  labels:
    {{- include "toolkit-common.labels" (dict "root" .root "name" .unit) | nindent 4 }}
  {{- with .ingress.annotations }}
  annotations:
    {{- toYaml . | nindent 4 }}
  {{- end }}
spec:
  {{- with .ingress.className }}
  ingressClassName: {{ . }}
  {{- end }}
  {{- with .ingress.tls }}
  tls:
    {{- toYaml . | nindent 4 }}
  {{- end }}
  rules:
    - host: {{ required "ingress.host is required when the ingress is enabled" .ingress.host | quote }}
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: {{ .service }}
                port:
                  name: {{ .port }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/flight-control/charts/toolkit-common/templates/_serviceaccount.tpl
{{/*
ServiceAccount. Call with (dict "root" $ "name" "<sa name>" "unit" "<unit>"
"automount" <bool>). `automount` is true only for a unit that validates
platform tokens: TokenReview is called with this token. The platform token a
unit presents is a separate projected volume (see toolkit-common.deployment).
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.serviceAccount" -}}
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: {{ .name }}
  labels:
    {{- include "toolkit-common.labels" (dict "root" .root "name" .unit) | nindent 4 }}
automountServiceAccountToken: {{ .automount | default false }}
{{- end }}

{{/*
TokenReview RBAC for one validating unit. Call with (dict "root" $ "unit"
"<unit>" "serviceAccount" "<sa name>").
*/}}
{{- define "toolkit-common.tokenReviewRbac" -}}
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-%s-tokenreview" .root.Release.Namespace .unit | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    {{- include "toolkit-common.labels" (dict "root" .root "name" .unit) | nindent 4 }}
rules:
  - apiGroups: ["authentication.k8s.io"]
    resources: ["tokenreviews"]
    verbs: ["create"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-%s-tokenreview" .root.Release.Namespace .unit | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    {{- include "toolkit-common.labels" (dict "root" .root "name" .unit) | nindent 4 }}
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: {{ printf "%s-%s-tokenreview" .root.Release.Namespace .unit | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: {{ .serviceAccount }}
    namespace: {{ .root.Release.Namespace }}
{{- end }}
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/flight-control/files/flight-control.yaml
# CF/Gears Flight Control: production configuration for the kubernetes profile.
#
# The control-plane unit of a distributed deployment (DESIGN § Flight Control
# Composition; gears-rust ADR-0011 §1). Build the image with
#   cargo build -p cf-gears-flight-control --no-default-features --features oidc-authn,k8s
# `config/flight-control.yaml` stays the development configuration (static
# accept-all AuthN, UDS hub, single listener).
#
# This file is the chart's configuration template: `templates/configmap.yaml`
# renders it with `tpl`, so template expressions appear only inside quoted strings and
# the file stays YAML that `tests/production_config.rs` parses as it is. Values
# that differ per deployment come from the chart's values (namespace, platform
# audience, OIDC issuer and audience); nothing here is a secret.
#
# Listeners (one Deployment, replicas: 1, strategy: Recreate, no HPA: the
# directory is this process's in-memory map):
#   8087  public   -- exposed operations, proxied worker routes, docs; the only
#                     port given an Ingress. External platform tokens are
#                     removed before anything else sees the request.
#   8088  internal -- every co-hosted operation for in-cluster callers; the
#                     endpoint advertised in the directory. ClusterIP only.
#   8089  health   -- /healthz, /readyz, /health for the kubelet. In no Service.
#   50051 gRPC hub -- DirectoryService for workers (TOOLKIT_DIRECTORY_ENDPOINT),
#                     platform enforcement required. ClusterIP only.

server:
  home_dir: "/var/lib/flight-control"

logging:
  default:
    console_level: info

gears:
  api-gateway:
    config:
      bind_addr: "0.0.0.0:8087"
      # The public Service DNS (not used for directory registration while the
      # internal listener is set).
      advertise_uri: "http://flight-control.{{ .Release.Namespace }}.svc.cluster.local:8087"
      internal_bind_addr: "0.0.0.0:8088"
      # The internal Service DNS, advertised in the directory.
      internal_advertise_uri: "http://flight-control-internal.{{ .Release.Namespace }}.svc.cluster.local:8088"
      public:
        exposed_only: true
      enable_docs: true
      cors_enabled: false
      auth_disabled: false
      require_auth_by_default: true
      defaults:
        body_limit_bytes: 16777216
      health:
        serve: separate
        bind_addr: "0.0.0.0:8089"
      gateway_proxy:
        enabled: true
        # The edge polls its own process's hub over loopback.
        directory_endpoint: "http://127.0.0.1:50051"
      # Platform plane: validates platform tokens on the internal listener and
      # attaches this pod's projected token to the edge's directory polls.
      internal_auth:
        provider: kube
        # The platform audience the projected tokens are minted for.
        audiences: ["{{ .Values.platformAudience }}"]
        token_path: "/var/run/secrets/tokens/{{ .Values.platformAudience }}"

  service-discovery:
    config:
      # The namespace platform workloads run in (the chart adds
      # `platformNamespaces`). Empty would disable the namespace check: a
      # ServiceAccount named like a gear in any namespace could then register
      # or deregister that gear.
      platform_namespaces: ["{{ .Release.Namespace }}"]

  grpc-hub:
    config:
      listen_addr: "0.0.0.0:50051"
      # The hub's Service DNS (no port: the bound port is appended).
      advertise_addr: "flight-control-grpc.{{ .Release.Namespace }}.svc.cluster.local"
      internal_auth:
        provider: kube
        audiences: ["{{ .Values.platformAudience }}"]
        token_path: "/var/run/secrets/tokens/{{ .Values.platformAudience }}"
      internal_auth_enforcement: required

  types-registry:
    config: {}

  # Tenant plane: OIDC bearer validation at the edge.
  authn-resolver:
    config:
      vendor: "constructorfabric"

  oidc-authn-plugin:
    config:
      vendor: "constructorfabric"
      priority: 100
      jwt:
        require_audience: true
        # The audience this platform's access tokens carry.
        expected_audience: ["{{ .Values.oidc.audience }}"]
        # The IdP issuer.
        trusted_issuers:
          - issuer: "{{ .Values.oidc.issuer }}"
        claim_mapping:
          subject_id: "sub"
          subject_tenant_id: "tenant_id"
          token_scopes: "scope"
      # S2S client-credentials exchange (tenant-scoped system work, ADR-0008).
      s2s_oauth:
        # Must yield an issuer listed in jwt.trusted_issuers.
        discovery_url: "{{ .Values.oidc.discoveryUrl | default .Values.oidc.issuer }}"
        # Applied when a client-credentials token carries no subject-type claim.
        default_subject_type: "gts.cf.core.security.subject_user.v1~"
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/flight-control/templates/_config.tpl
{{/*
The rendered configuration: `files/flight-control.yaml` through `tpl`, the
development AuthN swap, then `configOverlay`. The production rules of a
kubernetes unit (ADR-0011 §1/§3, test case P4 a/e) are checked on the result,
so an overlay cannot switch them off.
*/}}
{{- define "flight-control.config" -}}
{{- $cfg := tpl (.Files.Get "files/flight-control.yaml") . | fromYaml -}}
{{- $gears := $cfg.gears -}}
{{- if eq .Values.authn.mode "static" -}}
{{- $_ := unset $gears "oidc-authn-plugin" -}}
{{- $_ := set $gears "static-authn-plugin" (dict "config" (dict "mode" "accept_all")) -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- $cfg = mustMergeOverwrite $cfg (deepCopy .Values.configOverlay) -}}
{{- /* OIDC inputs are checked on the merged configuration: the chart's `oidc`
       values or a description's own plugin configuration (Gearbox passes it
       in `configOverlay`) may supply them. */ -}}
{{- if eq .Values.authn.mode "oidc" -}}
{{- $jwt := $cfg.gears | dig "oidc-authn-plugin" "config" "jwt" dict -}}
{{- $issuers := dig "trusted_issuers" list $jwt -}}
{{- $issuer := "" -}}
{{- if $issuers }}{{- $issuer = toString (dig "issuer" "" (index $issuers 0)) -}}{{- end -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list $issuer "oidc.issuer is required with authn.mode: oidc (or the oidc-authn-plugin's jwt.trusted_issuers in configOverlay)") -}}
{{- $audience := dig "expected_audience" list $jwt -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (and $audience (index $audience 0)) "oidc.audience is required with authn.mode: oidc (or the oidc-authn-plugin's jwt.expected_audience in configOverlay)") -}}
{{- /* The S2S discovery URL defaults to the effective issuer -- the plugin
       refuses an empty one at startup. */ -}}
{{- $plugin := index $cfg.gears "oidc-authn-plugin" "config" -}}
{{- $s2s := dig "s2s_oauth" dict $plugin -}}
{{- if not (dig "discovery_url" "" $s2s) -}}
{{- $_ := set $s2s "discovery_url" $issuer -}}
{{- $_ := set $plugin "s2s_oauth" $s2s -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- /* A private IdP CA, mounted by the Deployment. */ -}}
{{- if .Values.oidc.caConfigMap -}}
{{- $client := dig "http_client" dict $plugin -}}
{{- $paths := dig "custom_ca_certificate_paths" list $client -}}
{{- $ca := printf "/app/oidc-ca/%s" .Values.oidc.caKey -}}
{{- if not (has $ca $paths) -}}
{{- $_ := set $client "custom_ca_certificate_paths" (append $paths $ca) -}}
{{- $_ := set $plugin "http_client" $client -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- $gw := $cfg.gears | dig "api-gateway" "config" dict -}}
{{- $hub := $cfg.gears | dig "grpc-hub" "config" dict -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (eq (toString (dig "public" "exposed_only" false $gw)) "true") "production rule: api-gateway public.exposed_only must be true (ADR-0011 §1)") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (dig "internal_bind_addr" "" $gw) "production rule: a kubernetes unit needs the internal listener, api-gateway internal_bind_addr (ADR-0011 §1)") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (eq (dig "internal_auth" "provider" "" $gw) "kube") "production rule: api-gateway internal_auth.provider must be kube (ADR-0011 §3)") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (eq (dig "internal_auth" "provider" "" $hub) "kube") "production rule: grpc-hub internal_auth.provider must be kube (ADR-0011 §3)") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (eq (toString (dig "internal_auth_enforcement" "" $hub)) "required") "production rule: grpc-hub internal_auth_enforcement must be required (ADR-0011 §3)") -}}
{{- $listen := toString (dig "listen_addr" "" $hub) -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (and $listen (ne $listen "none") (not (hasPrefix "uds://" $listen))) "production rule: a kubernetes hub listens on TCP (ADR-0011 §1)") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (dig "service-discovery" "config" "platform_namespaces" list $cfg.gears) "production rule: service-discovery platform_namespaces must not be empty") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (ne (toString (dig "auth_disabled" false $gw)) "true") "production rule: api-gateway auth_disabled must be false (ADR-0011 section 3)") -}}
{{- if eq .Values.authn.mode "oidc" -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.require" (list (not (hasKey $cfg.gears "static-authn-plugin")) "production rule: authn.mode oidc admits no static-authn-plugin, whose default mode accepts everyone") -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- /* Each listener on the port its Service and container expose: an overlay that
       swapped them would put internal operations behind the public Service. */ -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.requirePort" (list (dig "bind_addr" "" $gw) 8087 "api-gateway bind_addr (public)") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.requirePort" (list (dig "internal_bind_addr" "" $gw) 8088 "api-gateway internal_bind_addr") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.requirePort" (list (dig "health" "bind_addr" "" $gw) 8089 "api-gateway health.bind_addr") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.requirePort" (list $listen 50051 "grpc-hub listen_addr") -}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.noLiteralSecrets" (list $cfg "configuration") -}}
{{- toYaml $cfg -}}
{{- end }}

=== helm/integration-demo/charts/flight-control/templates/deployment.yaml
{{- $env := list -}}
{{- range .Values.secretEnv -}}
{{- $env = append $env (dict "name" .name "valueFrom" (dict "secretKeyRef" (dict "name" .secretName "key" .key))) -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- $volumes := list -}}
{{- $mounts := list -}}
{{- if and (eq .Values.authn.mode "oidc") .Values.oidc.caConfigMap -}}
{{- $volumes = append $volumes (dict "name" "oidc-ca" "configMap" (dict "name" .Values.oidc.caConfigMap "items" (list (dict "key" .Values.oidc.caKey "path" .Values.oidc.caKey)))) -}}
{{- $mounts = append $mounts (dict "name" "oidc-ca" "mountPath" "/app/oidc-ca" "readOnly" true) -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- $w := dict
  "image" .Values.image
  "replicas" .Values.replicas
  "strategy" .Values.strategy
  "serviceAccount" "flight-control"
  "automountServiceAccountToken" true
  "args" (list "--config" "/app/config/flight-control.yaml" "run")
  "configMap" "flight-control-config"
  "configFile" "flight-control.yaml"
  "homeDir" "/var/lib/flight-control"
  "env" $env
  "extraVolumes" $volumes
  "extraVolumeMounts" $mounts
  "ports" (list
    (dict "name" "public" "containerPort" 8087)
    (dict "name" "internal" "containerPort" 8088)
    (dict "name" "health" "containerPort" 8089)
    (dict "name" "grpc" "containerPort" 50051))
  "probes" (dict "port" "health" "liveness" "/healthz" "readiness" "/readyz")
  "platformToken" (dict "enabled" true "audience" .Values.platformAudience)
  "resources" .Values.resources
  "nodeSelector" .Values.nodeSelector
  "tolerations" .Values.tolerations
  "affinity" .Values.affinity
-}}
{{- include "toolkit-common.deployment" (dict "root" $ "unit" "flight-control" "w" $w "configChecksum" (include "flight-control.config" . | sha256sum)) }}

=== helm/integration-demo/charts/flight-control/values-dev.yaml
# Development preset: accept-all tenant AuthN, for a local cluster. Never a
# production preset: the image must be built with `static-authn` (the default
# feature) and `k8s`. Platform-plane rules (internal listener, TokenReview,
# enforced hub, exposed-only public listener) stay exactly as in production.
authn:
  mode: static
image:
  pullPolicy: Never

=== helm/integration-demo/charts/flight-control/values.yaml
# Production defaults (gears-rust ADR-0004 amendment, ADR-0011 §1/§3). The
# development preset is `values-dev.yaml`; nothing in this file is a secret.

image:
  # The image built from `deploy/docker/flight-control.Dockerfile` with
  # `--no-default-features --features oidc-authn,k8s`.
  repository: flight-control
  tag: ""
  # When set, wins over `tag`.
  digest: ""
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

# The directory is this process's memory: one replica, replaced, never
# scaled. `values.schema.json` refuses anything else -- a RollingUpdate surge
# would start a second, independent registry.
replicas: 1
strategy: Recreate
autoscaling:
  enabled: false

# Tenant AuthN: `oidc` in production. `static` (accept-all) exists only for the
# development preset and needs an image built with `static-authn`.
authn:
  mode: oidc
oidc:
  # Required with `authn.mode: oidc`.
  issuer: ""
  audience: ""
  # Defaults to the issuer.
  discoveryUrl: ""
  # An IdP whose certificate a private CA issued: the ConfigMap holding that CA
  # (PEM, under `caKey`). It is mounted read-only and added to the plugin's
  # `http_client.custom_ca_certificate_paths`; the public roots stay trusted.
  caConfigMap: ""
  caKey: ca.crt

# The audience platform tokens are minted for; every unit uses the same one.
platformAudience: toolkit-internal

# Environment variables read from existing Secrets only, for `${VAR}`
# placeholders in the configuration:
#   - {name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET, secretName: flight-control-oidc, key: client-secret}
secretEnv: []

# Merged over the rendered configuration, for keys the values above do not
# cover. The production rules are checked after the merge.
configOverlay: {}

# Only the public listener (8087) is ever given an Ingress.
ingress:
  enabled: false
  className: ""
  host: ""
  annotations: {}
  tls: []

resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 192Mi
  limits:
    memory: 512Mi

nodeSelector: {}
tolerations: []
affinity: {}

=== helm/integration-demo/values.schema.json
{
  "$comment": "GENERATED by gearbox <version> -- do not edit. Run `gearbox generate` to regenerate.",
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "authz": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "affinity": true,
        "automountServiceAccountToken": {
          "description": "Whether the pod gets a Kubernetes API token mounted.\n\n`false`, which is a hardening rather than an inconvenience: nothing in a\ngenerated topology talks to the API server. The runtime's resolver set is\nDirectory, Null and Static -- the absence of a cluster-native one is what\nGBX0603 reports -- so the token would be an unused credential inside every\npod, which is the kind of thing a policy scanner is right to flag.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "commonAnnotations": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "Annotations for this subchart's resources only.",
          "type": [
            "object",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "commonLabels": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "Labels for this subchart's resources only.\n\nThe narrower half of the pair: `global.commonLabels` covers the product,\nthis covers one process. Both are merged on top of the standard\n`app.kubernetes.io/*` set rather than replacing it -- a policy label and a\nselector label are not competing for the same slot.",
          "type": [
            "object",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "containerSecurityContext": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "description": "The container's security context. Open for the same reason.",
              "properties": {
                "allowPrivilegeEscalation": {
                  "type": "boolean"
                },
                "capabilities": {
                  "properties": {
                    "drop": {
                      "description": "`ALL`, in capitals, because the admission controller compares case-sensitively.\n\nThe template this replaced wrote `all`. Pod Security Admission matches the\ndropped capability against the literal `ALL`, so a chart carrying the\nlowercase spelling is refused by the very `restricted` profile it was\nwritten to satisfy -- while looking, in a diff, exactly right.",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "type": "array"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "drop"
                  ],
                  "type": "object"
                },
                "readOnlyRootFilesystem": {
                  "type": "boolean"
                },
                "runAsNonRoot": {
                  "type": "boolean"
                },
                "seccompProfile": {
                  "properties": {
                    "type": {
                      "description": "Serialized as `type`, which is a Rust keyword.",
                      "type": "string"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "type"
                  ],
                  "type": "object"
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "runAsNonRoot",
                "readOnlyRootFilesystem",
                "allowPrivilegeEscalation",
                "seccompProfile",
                "capabilities"
              ],
              "type": "object"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "The container's security context. Same reasoning, worse starting point.\n\nThis one had no `.Values` escape at all: the template called the helper\nunconditionally, so `readOnlyRootFilesystem` and the dropped capabilities\nwere not adjustable by any means short of a replacement template."
        },
        "custom": {
          "additionalProperties": true,

=== helm/integration-demo/values.yaml
# Yours to edit. `gearbox generate` merges its changes into this file and keeps
# yours; an overlap it cannot reconcile is reported as GBX0701 and leaves the
# file untouched. See `values.generated.yaml` for what the lock decided, verbatim.

global:
  commonLabels: {}
  commonAnnotations: {}
authz:
  database:
    existingSecret: integration-db
    passwordEnv: GEARS_PG_PASSWORD
  enabled: true
  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    repository: gbx-authz
    tag: 0.1.0
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  serviceAccount:
    create: true
    name: authz-resolver
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 512Mi
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
  extraVolumes:
  - name: platform-token
    projected:
      sources:
      - serviceAccountToken:
          audience: toolkit-internal
          expirationSeconds: 3600
          path: toolkit-internal
  extraVolumeMounts:
  - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/tokens
    name: platform-token
    readOnly: true
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 65532
    fsGroup: 65532
  containerSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    seccompProfile:
      type: RuntimeDefault
    capabilities:
      drop:
      - ALL
  livenessProbe:
    enabled: true
    initialDelaySeconds: 0
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold: 3
  readinessProbe:
    enabled: true
    initialDelaySeconds: 0
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 1
